select * from eds.DEPOSIT_MTD_YTD_UAT


 SELECT
		CAST('2024-07-31' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE,
		LE.EXTERNAL_REF AS CUSTOMER_ID,
		COUNT(LE.ID) AS TRY_ACCT_CNT
    FROM EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITY AS LE
	CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF, '|')
    WHERE 

		    LE.STATUS = 'ENABLED' AND LE.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
		--AND CAST('2024-07-31' AS DATE) BETWEEN LE.SCD_START_DATE AND LE.SCD_END_DATE
		AND LEFT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF,1)='R'
	GROUP BY 
		LE.EXTERNAL_REF



    SELECT *  from (select 'R00000471|R01894256' External_Ref union all select 'R00000471' External_Ref ) BTL
CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.External_Ref, '|')


   SELECT
		CAST('2024-07-31' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE,
		LE.EXTERNAL_REF AS CUSTOMER_ID,
		COUNT(value) AS TRY_ACCT_CNT
    FROM EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITY AS LE
	CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF, '|')
    WHERE 

		    LE.STATUS = 'ENABLED' AND LE.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
		AND CAST('2024-07-31' AS DATE) BETWEEN LE.SCD_START_DATE AND LE.SCD_END_DATE
		AND LEFT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF,1)='R'
		AND LE.EXTERNAL_REF='R00000471|R01894256'
	GROUP BY 
		LE.EXTERNAL_REF



    SELECT
		CAST('2024-07-31' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE,
		value AS CUSTOMER_ID,
		COUNT( LE.ID) AS TRY_ACCT_CNT
    FROM EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITY AS LE
	CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF, '|')
    WHERE 

		    LE.STATUS = 'ENABLED' AND LE.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
		AND CAST('2024-07-31' AS DATE) BETWEEN LE.SCD_START_DATE AND LE.SCD_END_DATE
		AND LEFT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF,1)='R'
		AND LE.EXTERNAL_REF='R00000471|R01894256'
	GROUP BY 
		value
